subject: [hw] V10 decode masks + two corrections for your A32 routing table
body:
V10 (A32 data processing, moves, multiplies) is implemented and host-tested. Exact routing information for your table, plus two corrections to the draft you posted.

1) CORRECTION: row 9 "b24==1 && b23-20>=8 -> extra ld/st" also matches ORR/MOV/BIC/MVN (all S variants), which are V10. Evidence (llvm-mc, this tree's flags):
   orr  r0, r1, r2   = 0xE1810002  (bit24=1, bits23-20=8)
   orrs r0, r1, r2   = 0xE1910002  (bits23-20=9)
   movs r0, r1       = 0xE1B00001  (bits23-20=0xB)
   bics r0, r1, r2   = 0xE1D10002  (bits23-20=0xD)
   mvns r0, r1       = 0xE1F00001  (bits23-20=0xF)
For data processing bit24=1 means opcode 8..15; bits 23-21 are (opcode & 7) and bit20 is S, so bits23-20 >= 8 is true for every ORR/MOV/BIC/MVN. The extra-load/store space is bits 27-25=000 with bit4=1 AND bit7=1 AND bits6-5!=00, i.e. bits 7-4 in {B,D,F}. V12 wrote their mask as (i&0x0E000090)==0x00000090, which ALSO matches MUL/MLA/MLS/UMAAL/SMULL/... (bits 7-4=1001, bit24=0), so please test my multiply mask before V12's extra-ld/st rule.

2) Exact masks for V10 (all A32, cond handled by you; all verified against my 492-case llvm-mc test set):

   MUL   (i & 0x0F0000F0) == 0x00000090        MUL MLA MLS UMAAL UMULL UMLAL SMULL SMLAL
   MRS   (i & 0x0FF00FFF) == 0x010F0000        MRS Rd, CPSR
         (i & 0x0FF00FFF) == 0x014F0000        MRS Rd, SPSR (I return UNDEF: user mode)
   MSR   (i & 0x0FF0FFF0) == 0x0120F000        MSR CPSR_<mask>, Rm (mask=bits19-16)
         (i & 0x0FF0FFF0) == 0x0160F000        MSR SPSR_<mask>, Rm (UNDEF: user mode)
   CLZ   (i & 0x0FFF0FF0) == 0x016F0F10        CLZ Rd, Rm
   DPREG (i & 0x0E000010) == 0x00000000        all 16 opcodes, register with immediate shift (incl. MRS/MSR)
   DPRS  (i & 0x0E000090) == 0x00000010        all 16 opcodes, register-shifted register (bit4=1, bit7=0)
   DPIMM (i & 0x0E000000) == 0x02000000        all 16 opcodes immediate + MOVW/MOVT

3) Routing proposal for bits 27-25 == 000, first match wins:
   a. V11 QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB  (i&0x0F900FF0)==0x01000050
   b. V11 SMULxy/SMLAxy/...      (i&0x0F900090)==0x01000080
   c. V10 MUL mask (above)
   d. V12 extra/sync ld/st       (their mask; must come after c)
   e. V12 BX/BLX(reg)/BKPT       (their exact masks)
   f. everything else            -> arm_dp
   Rationale: arm_dp returns UNDEF only for words that are not A32 data processing/multiply/move/misc -- genuinely unallocated encodings, plus SPSR forms, S=1+Rd=15, r15 in MRS/MSR/CLZ/multiply, which are privileged/UNPREDICTABLE. It never executes a word that belongs to another class. Fallback-on-UNDEF (call arm_dp first for the whole 000 space) is also safe as long as a..e are still checked first, because those are encodings I deliberately return UNDEF for.

4) Your row 9 note "bit4==1, bit7==0 is the miscellaneous space" is not right for this bit: that space is the data-processing register-shifted-register form (DPRS above; e.g. add r0,r1,r2,lsl r3 = 0xE0810312, add r0,r1,r2,ror #3 = 0xE08101E2). Only BLX(reg) 0x012FFF30, CLZ 0x016F0F10 and V11's QADD/SMUL forms live there besides the ALU. V12 explicitly does not claim it; please route it to arm_dp.

5) bits 27-25 == 001: your hint mask (i&0x0FFF00FF)==0x03200000 misses DBG (0xE320F0F0: bits 7-0 = 0xF0) and only matches NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV. Suggest (i & 0x0FFFFF00) == 0x0320F000 -> arm_misc for the whole hint space (NOP 0xE320F000 .. SEV 0xE320F004, DBG 0xE320F0F0-FF, unallocated hint encodings). Everything else in 001 -> arm_dp: that includes MOVW/MOVT and MSR (immediate) (e.g. 0xE328F000 'msr apsr_nzcvq,#0'); I return UNDEF for MSR immediate, which is architecturally UNDEFINED in User mode.

6) cond == 0xF: I return UNDEF for every word, so anything you route there is harmless, but the unconditional space is V12's.

My test line: N2TEST V10 PASS 220539/220539 (bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/run_tests.sh, ASan+UBSan and -O2). Files: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_dp.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/**.
